description.value: You study a creature you can see within range, and the Force reveals a weakness in its defenses. The target must succeed on a Charisma save. On a failure, you gain advantage on all your attack rolls against it while it suffers disadvantage on its attacks against you for the duration. On a success, you instead gain advantage only on your next attack against it, and it suffers disadvantage only on its next attack against you — the power ends once both of those attacks have been made.
